highlightPrefix: In the beginning God created
text: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
meditation: Pause and give thanks for the Creator who formed the sky, earth, and every breath.

highlightPrefix: The LORD is my strength and song,
text: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation.
meditation: Let gratitude become your melody even when the road ahead feels steep.

highlightPrefix: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:
text: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
meditation: Receive this ancient blessing quietly and wish the same peace on someone you love.

highlightPrefix: Be strong and of a good courage,
text: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
meditation: Whatever faces you today, you do not step into it unattended.

highlightPrefix: Be strong and of a good courage;
text: Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
meditation: Breathe out worry and take one steady, faithful step forward.

highlightPrefix: Whither thou goest, I will go;
text: Whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God.
meditation: Reflect on steadfast kindness and how loyalty heals lonely hearts.

highlightPrefix: For the LORD seeth not as man seeth;
text: For the LORD seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.
meditation: Quietly examine your motives today and nurture gentleness within.

highlightPrefix: O give thanks unto the LORD;
text: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
meditation: Name three simple blessings from this week and offer thanks for each one.

highlightPrefix: For the joy of the LORD is your strength.
text: Neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
meditation: Joy in God is not fragile cheerfulness; it is deep endurance for weary days.

highlightPrefix: For I know that my redeemer liveth,
text: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth.
meditation: Even in seasons of questions, anchor your spirit in a living Redeemer.

highlightPrefix: Blessed is the man
text: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, but his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
meditation: Carry one phrase of Scripture in your thoughts through both morning and evening.

highlightPrefix: The LORD is my shepherd;
text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want. He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
meditation: Picture still water in silence and let hurried thoughts settle before God.

highlightPrefix: The LORD is my light and my salvation;
text: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
meditation: Where shadows feel heavy, invite God's steady light into that corner of your heart.

highlightPrefix: O taste and see that the LORD is good:
text: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
meditation: God's goodness is meant to be experienced slowly, not merely read about.

highlightPrefix: Be still, and know that I am God:
text: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
meditation: Release control for sixty quiet seconds and rest in who God is.

highlightPrefix: Create in me a clean heart, O God;
text: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
meditation: Ask God to refresh your spirit and sweep away lingering bitterness or fatigue.

highlightPrefix: He that dwelleth in the secret place
text: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress.
meditation: Step away from noise and remember you are sheltered in God's care.

highlightPrefix: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving,
text: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
meditation: Begin prayer with thankfulness before bringing any request.

highlightPrefix: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet,
text: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
meditation: A lamp lights the next step clearly even when the whole mile is still unseen.

highlightPrefix: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills,
text: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
meditation: Look upward past today's obstacles toward the Maker of heaven and earth.

highlightPrefix: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart;
text: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
meditation: Surrender the need to figure out every outcome and ask God to steer your path.

highlightPrefix: Commit thy works unto the LORD,
text: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
meditation: Dedicate today's ordinary tasks as an offering of love and honesty.

highlightPrefix: The name of the LORD is a strong tower:
text: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
meditation: Run inward to prayer first whenever anxiety knocks.

highlightPrefix: To every thing there is a season,
text: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven.
meditation: Honor the season you are in today without rushing God's timing.

highlightPrefix: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace,
text: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
meditation: Focus your mind gently on God's faithfulness until restless thoughts grow calm.

highlightPrefix: But they that wait upon the LORD
text: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary.
meditation: Waiting on God is not wasted time; it is how tired wings regain lift.

highlightPrefix: Fear thou not; for I am with thee:
text: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee.
meditation: Hear God's personal promise: I am with you, I will strengthen you, I will help you.

highlightPrefix: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,
text: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
meditation: Trust that God's purposes for your tomorrow are woven with mercy and hope.

highlightPrefix: It is of the LORD's mercies
text: It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
meditation: Welcome today as a fresh page filled with new compassion from above.

highlightPrefix: Do justly, and to love mercy,
text: What doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
meditation: Look for one practical way to show mercy and walk humbly with God today.

highlightPrefix: The LORD God is my strength,
text: The LORD God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds' feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places.
meditation: Even before circumstances change, God gives steady footing on rocky paths.

highlightPrefix: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty;
text: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love.
meditation: Be amazed today that the God of heaven delights over His children with singing.

highlightPrefix: Ye are the light of the world.
text: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid. Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works.
meditation: A single act of quiet kindness can brighten someone's entire day.

highlightPrefix: But seek ye first the kingdom of God,
text: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
meditation: Put God first in the quiet of your morning and let smaller worries take second place.

highlightPrefix: Come unto me, all ye that labour
text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
meditation: Set down the burden you were never meant to carry alone and receive Christ's rest.

highlightPrefix: For with God nothing shall be impossible.
text: For with God nothing shall be impossible.
meditation: Bring the prayer that feels too large for human strength before the Almighty.

highlightPrefix: For God so loved the world,
text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
meditation: Rest in the depth of God's generous, self-giving love for you.

highlightPrefix: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you:
text: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
meditation: Breathe deeply and welcome a peace that does not depend on noisy headlines.

highlightPrefix: I am the vine, ye are the branches:
text: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
meditation: Stay connected to Christ in stillness; fruitfulness flows from abiding, not striving.

highlightPrefix: And we know that all things work together for good
text: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
meditation: God can weave even unexpected detours into something redemptive and good.

highlightPrefix: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation;
text: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer.
meditation: Keep a gentle rhythm of short, honest prayers throughout your day.

highlightPrefix: Let all your things be done with charity.
text: Let all your things be done with charity.
meditation: Let love guide the tone of every conversation and reply today.

highlightPrefix: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)
text: For we walk by faith, not by sight.
meditation: Walk steadily in trust even when you cannot yet see around the next bend.

highlightPrefix: And let us not be weary in well doing:
text: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
meditation: Your quiet faithfulness is noticed by God even when results feel slow.

highlightPrefix: And be ye kind one to another,
text: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
meditation: Offer someone today the same grace you have freely received.

highlightPrefix: Be careful for nothing;
text: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God shall keep your hearts.
meditation: Trade each anxious thought for a specific prayer wrapped in gratitude.

highlightPrefix: I can do all things through Christ
text: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
meditation: Draw strength from Christ for the exact responsibility sitting in front of you.

highlightPrefix: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for,
text: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
meditation: Faith sees God's promise clearly before the horizon catches up.

highlightPrefix: Casting all your care upon him;
text: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
meditation: God genuinely cares about what weighs on your mind today.

highlightPrefix: And God shall wipe away all tears
text: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain.
meditation: Remember the promised horizon where every sorrow is gently healed forever.
